findings.current: the last shred of faith I’d held on to crumble, along with everything I’d thought I knew about this world.
findings.defect: The Korean says a handful of belief crumbles along with the common sense of this place. “Last” adds an unsupported implication that this was the narrator’s final remaining faith, and “everything I’d thought I knew” broadens the second image beyond common sense.
findings.rationale: 한 줌의 믿음 means a handful of faith; 이곳에서의 상식 is the common sense of this place.
findings.replacement: I felt the handful of faith I’d held in my heart crumble, along with the common sense of this world.

findings.current: an immense, invisible force descended on me.
findings.defect: “Descended” adds a downward trajectory. The source says a powerful invisible force came rushing toward the narrator, without specifying that it came from above.
findings.rationale: 나를 향해 들이닥치다 describes a force surging toward the narrator; the following gravity spell is introduced separately.
findings.replacement: an immense, invisible force came rushing at me.

findings.defect: The source specifically describes fragmented corpses floating in the blood. “Broken bodies” loses that physical detail.
findings.rationale: 조각난 시체들 means corpses broken into pieces, not merely injured or broken bodies.

summary: The assembled chapter is largely faithful, with a few small shifts in physical detail and imagery.
